name: web-cinema-404-page-with-seat-grid-and-one-red-seat
title: Dark cinema site 404 as a grid of seats with one glowing red seat and 'This seat doesn't exist'
whatItIs: A dark browser window with a red condensed logo and nav, a large grid of rounded grey seat squares with one lit red seat, a white bold message 'THIS SEAT DOESN'T EXIST' and a grey subtitle, a white Back to Home pill and a footer link grid.
whatItMeans: Witty and on-theme; the missing seat turns an error into a cinema joke.
techniques: Use the product's own metaphor (seat map) for the error.
Provide a single white exit button.

vocabulary.definition: A grid of seats used as an interface.
An error page themed on the brand's product.
One red element in an otherwise grey scene.
A capsule button returning to the start.
